Six contiguous tandem repeats (29-30 aa) defined by strictly invariant CxxGxC and HxxxH coordination-like motifs, two conserved aromatic anchors (Ω), an invariant L, and three conserved basic (+) positions.

Twelve ~35-40 aa cysteine-rich repeats distributed across three clusters in the N-terminal and C-terminal regions, defined by four invariant cysteines (C...CxC...C), an invariant Yx[IV][GN]xxΩ core, and an invariant Gly following CxCx.

Three N-terminal helix-loop-helix (ankyrin-like) repeats anchored by invariant A at position 5, invariant LL dyad at positions 16-17, conserved aliphatic/hydrophobic core positions, and a C-terminal polar residue, separated by 7-aa and 27-aa linkers.

Seven invariant-length 23-aa cysteine-flanked acidic repeats anchored by fixed N1, C2, N7, Q10, D14, D16, G19, D20, and C22 positions, occurring as tandem pairs separated by 13-15 aa interstitial acidic linkers.

Four six-cysteine structured domain repeats separated by short 5-7 aa linkers, sharing conserved disulfide spacing, an aliphatic residue after C3, and a CxxGΩxG signature before C6 (with a 12-aa loop expansion in copy 2).

Five non-overlapping 13-aa cysteine-free DxDxD acidic repeats interspersed between and immediately after the 23-aa NC...GD[AV]C[DQ] repeats, anchored by invariant D2, D4, D6, and D13 plus conserved hydrophobic/His at position 8 and D/N at position 10.

Three dispersed C-capping helical motifs in the C-terminal helical domain sharing an N-terminal [AL]-[DE]-A triad and C-terminal [NK][HN]K basic-polar cluster (preceded 4-5 residues upstream by Y in all three copies).

Internal duplication of a 39-residue cysteine-rich domain separated by an 8-residue linker, anchored by eight invariant cysteines (including a central CC dipeptide), fixed G/P/D/L/S/A/R positions, and a conserved dibasic (RK/KR) cluster.

Three tandem 7-aa tyrosine-anchored repeats (2-aa and 0-aa gaps) at the disordered C-terminus, sharing [DN] at position 1, invariant Y at position 3, [LM] at position 4, and [EA] at position 7 in a 217-aa C-terminal half otherwise devoid of tyrosines.

Four ungapped 87-residue globular domain repeats separated by 56-79 aa disordered linkers, featuring invariant core motifs (S..G.[LF]A..LL..LFPELF, G...K..L-....IR[NH]Y...P, and W...[CF]...[LI][ND]-).
